summary: The blocking sheet styles-*.css is 537 876 B raw / 79.8 KB gzip / 59.4 KB br, and only 14.9% of its rule bytes are used on /. LH charges 450 ms FCP on mobile, but A/B (n=3) shows a used-only sheet buys just -0.21 s FCP / -0.20 s LCP on mobile and -0.05 s on desktop. A surface-split core (44.2 KB br) gives -0.15/-0.17 s. Elasticity is about 4-6 ms/KB br on mobile: a secondary lever worth about +1 to +2.5 mobile points. Surface splitting reaches about 250 KB raw / 42.7 KB gzip / 33.6 KB br. Stripping the color-mix fallback saves another -69 KB raw / -5 KB gzip. Critical-CSS inlining and content-visibility: not recommended. Inline <style> totals 133 KB (typography about 52 KB), and the new gate is render-blocking CSS <= 45 KB gzip.

findings.claim: Elasticity is about 4-6 ms of mobile FCP/LCP per KB br of blocking CSS and about 1 ms/KB on desktop. The measured ceiling for CSS-only work on / is about -0.2 s mobile, worth about +1 to +2.5 mobile score points and about 0 on desktop. CSS is a secondary lever. Lantern's pessimistic graph is dominated by about 480 KB gzip of boot modulepreload.

findings.claim: By layer: @layer utilities 334 262 B raw (40 084 gzip-9), of which 21 159 B are used on /. Unlayered hand rules plus top-level @media/@supports total about 161 KB raw. Hand CSS is 37% of the sheet.

670 @supports(color-mix(in lab,...)) blocks total 105 844 B raw (Tailwind opacity-modifier pattern). Their fallback is the OPAQUE colour, which is wrong anyway. Stripping the fallback and unwrapping the blocks saves -69 013 B raw / -5.0 KB gzip.

Profile (21 081 B, 922 used) and dock/chat (20 526 B, 506 used) are mostly unused. Admin leftovers total 2 337 B. Utilities whose candidates occur only in files not loaded on / come to 2 025 rules / 169 281 B raw / 22.6 KB gzip, all unused.

findings.claim: The existing doctrine (@source admin cut, check-bundle-size.ts:1885-1946 '~8% ceiling') covers only utilities scoped admin vs public, not moving hand CSS by surface. About 60 KB of hand CSS source is namespaced for non-public surfaces. The publicCss gate (budget 83 KB, summing every non-admin sheet at :2456-2461) cannot see a split and would slightly RISE after one.

Loading mechanisms that are safe for a split already exist in the build: TanStack Start SSR-links route-level CSS from the manifest (e.g. RichTextView css on /$, /support...); the Vite preload helper loads lazy-chunk CSS (fine for post-hydration UI, not for SSR-rendered React.lazy widgets); React 19 Float <link precedence='nes-widgets'> dedupes and holds the boundary reveal (doctrine in widgetStyleSheets.tsx); media=print links do not block.
findings.evidence: Verified in .output/server/_tanstack-start-manifest_v-DcVEtS0X.mjs, index-DPN2YAij.js deps, widgetStyleSheets.tsx:1-39, css.md §2

findings.claim: content-visibility:auto on the 3rd and later builder sections gives no gain. Mobile medians A->B: FCP 4.89->4.92 s (+0.03), LCP 5.59->5.60 s (+0.01), SI +0.03 s, TBT -55 ms (noisy), perf 59->61. Desktop was incomplete (run B desktop 3 failed, no median computed).
findings.evidence: ab-cv.log (measure-ab.sh, n=3 mobile). The report §6 defers to this log

findings.claim: Surface splitting reaches about 250 KB raw / 42.7 KB gzip / 33.6 KB br (stage 3), or about 205 KB / 39 KB / 31 KB with the color-mix strip. Reaching <=30 KB gzip would need per-widget builder CSS (49 KB raw of widget utilities is reachable from /, about 10 KB br, about -50 ms), which the report judges not worth the risk. Ideal lower bound: 89 295 B raw / 19 248 gzip / 16 057 br.

Critical-CSS inlining is not recommended. It buys only -0.06 s more than the structural split, adds about 19 KB gzip to every uncacheable 570 KB document, must be computed for each CMS document, and breaks the single-<link> head contract (rootHead.ts:52-70 vs :108-118).
findings.evidence: Difference between the critical and core A/B runs, css.md §0

findings.claim: Production / carries 51 inline <style> blocks totalling 133 103 B. Biggest are brand tokens 26 612 B, about 31 per-widget typography blocks at about 52 000 B (typographyCss.ts:78-233, same template per data-w-id), trending/ticker 14 848 B, slider shared 10 948 B, theme settings 10 306 B, sbw social 4 022 B and search 3 619 B. Moving the constant and typography parts out would cut the document by -45 to -75 KB raw. That is neutral for cold Lantern and helps HTML parse and caching.

Non-composited animations run during load: 6 in prod LH and 11 locally. Causes: tw-animate-css @keyframes enter always animates filter:blur on the consent banner (ConsentBanner.tsx:556-559, :703, plus backdrop-blur), slider dots transition width/height (sliderVariants.tsx:704, :1654), oi-fade-in on first-viewport card images (styles.css:1613-1628), and the MBB mbb-strok stroke-dashoffset (styles.css:7026-7033). Score impact is about 0.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse non-composited-animations audit (prod plus local), css.md §7

findings.claim: Fonts: red-hat-display-latin.woff2 is 30 672 B (the variable axis 300-399 is dead because @font-face declares 400 900). latin-ext.woff2 is 14 060 B, preloaded for PL, yet only 11 chars / 240 occurrences are used on /. swap and the metric-matched fallback are in place, and CLS is 0. A Polish-only subset (est. 2-3 KB) would take about 11 KB of High-priority bytes off the path ahead of the LCP image.

findings.metric: High-priority bytes before LCP; LCP mobile

changes.title: Per-widget typography as static rules plus custom properties
changes.mechanism: Replace about 31 per-widget <style> blocks (same template per data-w-id, !important) with one static core rule set keyed by presence attributes at the same specificity, e.g. [data-wt-fs][data-wt-fs][data-wt-fs] :is(p,span,...){font-size:var(--wt-fs)!important}. Device values come from --wt-fs-t/--wt-fs-m. The wrapper emits data-wt-fs style='--wt-fs:14px' (about 30 B instead of about 1.5 KB). Also move the constant trending/ticker, slider-shared, search and sbw hover CSS into static sheets.
changes.metric: document HTML bytes; HTML parse long tasks
changes.expected_effect: -45 to -75 KB raw document (typography about 52 KB plus constant sheets). Neutral for cold Lantern FCP; helps parse time and caching.
changes.estimate_basis: Production / inline style inventory (51 blocks, 133 103 B)
changes.risk_notes: Presence attributes are required: an unset var under !important computes to unset and breaks inheritance. Shared with the html-weight workstream. Effort not stated.
gates: visual parity of builder typography per device
changes.verification: Document size before/after plus visual diff of builder pages on mobile/tablet/desktop; measure-ab.sh
